tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.portable_.en: |aConverts UBMRU from the wearer's matrix to MRU
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.portable_.zh: |a将佩戴者矩阵中的 UBMRU 转化为 MRU

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.portable_.en: Same rate as the Matrix Destructor (10 UBMRU → 1 MRU by default), stores up to 5,000 MRU.|nStaffs and tools that use MRU draw from it first.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.portable_.zh: 比例和矩阵换能器一样（默认 10 UBMRU 换 1 MRU），最多存 5000 MRU。|n耗 MRU 的法杖、工具会先从它身上扣。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.ring_of_e.en: Gain |610% |cless UBMRU from kills|r, |nbut |ahave that number transformed to XP
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.ring_of_e.zh: |c击杀获得的 UBMRU 减少 |610%|r，|n但|a减少的部分会转化为经验

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.ring_of_e.en: Every %s UBMRU it takes becomes 1 experience point.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.ring_of_e.zh: 拿走的部分每 %s 点 UBMRU 变成 1 点经验。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.life_pend.en: Gain |630% |cless UBMRU from kills|r, |nbut |arestore some life each kill.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.life_pend.zh: |c击杀获得的 UBMRU 减少 |630%|r，|n但|a每次击杀会恢复一些生命值。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.wind_catc.en: Gain |cless wind relations|r, |nbut |ahave a |615% |achance to trap the wind on each event.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.wind_catc.zh: |c获得的风之好感减少|r，|n但|a每次风之事件有 |615%|a 的几率捕获一缕风。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.wind_catc.en: Worn with no other wind bonus, you gain no wind relations at all.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.wind_catc.zh: 只戴它、身上没有别的风之好感加成时，好感一点也不涨。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.doctors_b.en: Gain |cno UBMRU from kills|r,|nbut |ahalve the duration of negative effects.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.doctors_b.zh: |c击杀不再获得 UBMRU|r，|n但|a负面效果的持续时间减半。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.doctors_b.en: Affects Wither, Poison, Hunger, Blindness, Nausea, Mining Fatigue, Slowness and Weakness.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.doctors_b.zh: 对凋零、中毒、饥饿、失明、反胃、挖掘疲劳、缓慢、虚弱有效。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.epsilon_b.en: |aHostile mobs will sometimes drop different Embers.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.epsilon_b.zh: |a敌对生物有时会掉落各种余烬。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.epsilon_b.en: %s chance of one extra random Ember when you kill a hostile mob yourself (animals and players don't count).
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.epsilon_b.zh: 亲手击杀敌对生物时有 %s 的几率多掉一个随机余烬（动物、玩家不算）。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.alpha_rin.en: Gain |a500 UBMRU|r by drinking Magical Water.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.alpha_rin.zh: 喝下魔力水时|a额外获得 500 UBMRU|r。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.beta_ring.zh: 风的效果|d带上元素属性|r。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.delta_rin.en: Radiation lowers your maximum health as if its level were halved.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.delta_rin.zh: 辐射压低生命上限时，按一半的等级计算。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.zeta_amul.en: |cEach hit costs UBMRU|r, |nbut |athe target gets no invulnerability time: hit as fast as you can click.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.zeta_amul.zh: |c每次命中消耗 UBMRU|r，|n但|a目标没有受伤无敌时间，点多快打多快。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.zeta_amul.en: 300 UBMRU per hit. The attack cooldown still applies: rapid clicks deal less damage each.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.zeta_amul.zh: 每次命中 300 UBMRU。攻击冷却照旧，连点时每下的伤害会变小。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.eta_amule.zh: |c受到的伤害翻倍，|n|a造成的伤害也翻倍。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.theta_bel.en: |aResist a fatal hit |cat the cost of your UBMRU.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.theta_bel.zh: |a抵挡一次致命伤害，|c代价是消耗你的 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.theta_bel.en: Costs damage × 5,000 UBMRU (after armor); without enough UBMRU the hit goes through.|nDoes not stop the void or /kill. After it stops a hit, it rests for %s seconds.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.theta_bel.zh: 代价是这一下的伤害（算过护甲后）× 5000 UBMRU，不够就挡不住。|n挡不住虚空和 /kill。抵掉一次以后 %s 秒内不再生效。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.en: |aInflict radiation on enemies with each hit, |nbut |cgain radiation yourself each time you take damage.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.zh: |a每次攻击都会让敌人受到辐射，|n但|c你每次受伤也会受到辐射。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.d.en: %sHitting a mob: its maximum health drops along with the health you take off (never below 1; not for pets or mounts; restored when it is reloaded).%s
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.d.zh: %s打其他生物：它的生命上限跟着打掉的生命一起降（最低留 1，宠物和坐骑不降，重新加载后恢复）。%s

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.p.en: Hitting a player: +5,000 dose per point of damage, at most +%s per hit, and never pushes them above %s.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.p.zh: 打玩家：每点伤害让对方 +5000 剂量，一下最多 +%s，最多加到 %s（已经更高的不再加）；

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.s.en: |nTaking damage: +1,000 dose per point, up to the same limit.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.xi_belt.s.zh: |n自己受伤：每点伤害 +1000 剂量，同样最多加到上限。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.iota_ring.en: |cDecrease your damage by |610%, |nBut |adeal those |610% |aas unblockable damage.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.iota_ring.zh: |c你的伤害降低 |610%|c，|n但|a这 |610%|a 会作为无视护甲的伤害打出。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.iota_ring.en: After the magic hit, the target's invulnerability time is cleared.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.iota_ring.zh: 拆出来的那一下打完后，目标的受伤无敌时间清零。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.kappa_rin.zh: 定期|a获得 UBMRU|r|7，但|c会消耗饱食度。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.lambda_ri.en: |aRadiation fades much faster once you leave Hoanna.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.lambda_ri.zh: |a离开海纳尔后，辐射消退快得多。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.lambda_ri.en: Outside Hoanna: radiation dose falls by 65 per second instead of 5. No effect inside Hoanna.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.lambda_ri.zh: 不在海纳尔时剂量每秒消退 65（平时 5）；在海纳尔里没有作用。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.mu_ring.en: |cGain more radiation in Hoanna,|r |nbut |aget resistant to some of its calamities.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.mu_ring.zh: |c在海纳尔受到更多辐射，|r|n但|a能抵御海纳尔的部分天灾。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.mu_ring.d.en: +20 radiation dose per second while in Hoanna.|nImmune to the Sun Array's burning, Poison Fumes and strong quake jolts.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.mu_ring.d.zh: 在海纳尔每秒多 20 剂量。|n不受日阵灼烧、毒雾和地震强震的影响。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.nu_amulet.en: Gain |625% |cless UBMRU from kills|r, |nbut |adamage hostile mobs around you upon kills.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.nu_amulet.zh: |c击杀获得的 UBMRU 减少 |625%|r，|n但|a击杀时会伤害周围的敌对生物。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.nu_amulet.en: Up to 16 hostile mobs within 6 blocks horizontally and 3 vertically (nearest first), 3 damage each. Mobs it kills do not chain.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.nu_amulet.zh: 打周围水平 6 格、上下 3 格以内最多 16 只敌对生物（近的先），每只 3 点；被它打死的怪不会再连锁。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.omicron_a.en: |aBlocks yield more drops, |nbut |cit costs you UBMRU to break blocks.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.omicron_a.zh: |a破坏方块时掉落更多，|n但|c破坏方块要消耗 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.omicron_a.en: Non-block drops +1 per stack (not things placed and mined back, nor pot sherds), 500 UBMRU each time. Nothing is charged when there is nothing to add.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.omicron_a.zh: 非方块掉落每组 +1（放下再挖回来的、陶罐的陶片不算），每次 500 UBMRU；没有能加的掉落就不扣。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.pi_belt.zh: |a挖矿获得的经验变为 |6%s|a 倍。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.pi_belt.d.en: Only ores count by default. Ores that drop no experience have a 5%% chance to give 1 (not when what you mine drops the ore itself, e.g. with Silk Touch).
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.pi_belt.d.zh: 默认只算矿石；本来不掉经验的矿石有 5%% 的几率给 1 点（挖下来掉的就是矿石本身时不算，比如用精准采集）。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.rho_ring.en: |cGet no EXP for mining ores, |nBut |again UBMRU instead.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.rho_ring.zh: |c挖矿石不再获得经验，|n但|a改为获得 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.rho_ring..en: %s UBMRU per experience point. Only ores count by default.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.rho_ring..zh: 每点经验换 %s UBMRU。默认只算矿石。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.sigma_rin.en: |aGain a 10% chance to reflect damage taken.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.sigma_rin.zh: |a受到伤害时有 10% 几率反弹。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.tau_ring.en: |aKilling mobs yields more drops, |nbut |cit costs you UBMRU to kill creatures.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.tau_ring.zh: |a击杀生物掉落更多，|n但|c每次击杀要消耗 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.tau_ring..en: +0 to 2 per stack of the mob's own loot (not its gear%s), 1,000 UBMRU per kill.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.tau_ring..zh: 生物自己的掉落每组 +0～2（不含它身上的装备%s），每次 1000 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.upsilon_r.en: Works when you are the nearest player within 16 blocks.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.upsilon_r.zh: 你是离它最近的玩家、而且在 16 格以内时生效。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.phi_ring.en: |aAllows shearing various mobs for the |ccost of UBMRU
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.phi_ring.zh: |a可以剪取各种生物，|c但要消耗 UBMRU。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.phi_ring..en: Cows, chickens, squid, spiders, creepers, skeletons, magma cubes, slimes, zombies and snow golems.|n1,000 UBMRU and 32 shears durability each time.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.phi_ring..zh: 牛、鸡、鱿鱼、蜘蛛、苦力怕、骷髅、岩浆怪、史莱姆、僵尸、雪傀儡。|n每次 1000 UBMRU、剪刀 32 点耐久。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.chi_ring.en: Gain |6%s |amore XP from experience orbs, |nbut |cgain only half UBMRU from kills.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.chi_ring.zh: |a捡经验球时另得 |6%s|a 的经验，|n但|c击杀获得的 UBMRU 减半。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.psi_ring.en: |aMobs that target you attack other hostile mobs instead.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.psi_ring.zh: |a盯上你的怪物会改去打别的敌对生物。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.psi_ring..en: Never villagers or pets%s. A mob is redirected at most once every %s seconds.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.bauble.psi_ring..zh: 不会去打村民和宠物%s；同一只怪 %s 秒内只换一次目标。
